headline: Callum's Cape Contested Afresh as Godcrofts Erupts into Violence
war_summary: The western theatre has swung back into violent flux, with Callum's Cape re-erupting into furious contest as eleven base turnovers in the past two hours left the peninsula split between four Warden redoubts and three Colonial positions, claiming over two thousand lives across Naofa and Scouts Jest. Simultaneously, an abrupt flare-up struck Godcrofts, where seven rapid clashes around Isawa generated nearly a thousand casualties and multiple shifts in two hours. Mooring County remains a relentless meatgrinder, absorbing almost three thousand fresh dead in two hours with five further base overturns rocking The Wind Hills while Colonial defenders cling to a lone redoubt against eleven Warden bastions. In the central sector, Linn of Mercy reignited with six base actions concentrated at Outwich Ranch under surging Warden casualties, even as Weathered Expanse logged three additional transitions. Conversely, the tempest across Nevish Line has subsided into full Colonial control without an incident in two hours, while combat across Marban Hollow cooled to a near-standstill.
